system.description:
Some call them romantic; others call them reckless fools. Swashbucklers are those who stake everything on a daring move or a clever remark. They duel in the moonlight, swing from chandeliers, and gamble with a grin on their face and steel in their hand. They thrive when the stakes are high and the odds uneven. Where others see danger, they see a good time.

STARTING EVASION: 11
STARTING HP: 6

Thematic Items

A letter from a loved one or a mysterious pin

Rake’s Hope Feature

Daring Flourish. Spend 3 Hope to use a d20 as your Fear die until you fail an action roll or the scene ends.

Archetype Feature

Stylish Gambits

After you make an Action Roll but before the GM communicates the result, you may take a 1d4 penalty. If the roll still succeeds, you gain a D6 Style die. You may spend and roll a Style die to add its result to any roll you make. You can hold a number of Style dice up to your Finesse.

Stylish Strike

On a successful attack against an adversary, spend a Hope to halve your damage and make the target Humiliated by stylishly striking to wound their pride rather than their body. While Humiliated, the adversary deals half damage on all attacks until they successfully hit you or the scene ends.

You may replace an Archetype Feature with a Duelist Style. See Appendix for Duelist Styles.
backgroundQuestions: Why did the allure of adventure lead you astray from home?
Despite your fearless charm, what do you truly fear?
Who haunts your thoughts in both triumph and failure?
connections: How did I surprise you during our first confrontation?
What’s a truth about me no others know?
Why do you trust me so much despite how unreliable I can be?
